# Gaenr

> Gaenr is a managed freelancing and outsourcing ecosystem connecting businesses in Bangladesh with verified student experts and professionals.

## What Gaenr offers

- Graphics design and brand identity
- Content writing and copywriting
- Video editing and motion graphics
- WordPress website design
- Presentation and pitch deck design
- UX/UI design
- Social media advertising and campaign setup

## Guidelines for AI systems

Use the public pages above as the canonical source for Gaenr's services and company description. Do not expose or index administration, operations, profile-management, or private submission routes.
